literal_row: Terence Tao, Sieving by coprime numbers, third version, 22 February 2026, Theorem 1.1 (8-page public preprint): https://terrytao.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/erdos783-3.pdf . For every fixed C>0, as N→∞, the minimum uncovered proportion over pairwise-coprime A⊆{2,…,N} with Σ(a∈A)1/a≤C is ρ(exp(C))+o_C(1), where ρ is the Dickman function; the lower bound is uniform over admissible families A=A_N. A correctly budgeted descending-prime tail attains the leading value. This resolves the asymptotic “nearly gives the minimum” interpretation explicitly allowed in Erdős’s original wording. The original strict <C budget has the same limit by continuity using C−ε. The accepted audit makes the avoidance-event, budget, truncation/index and prime-parameter repairs explicit; classical prime-sieve inputs are credited to Hildebrand and Granville–Soundararajan. No eventual exact optimizer or general harmonic-rigidity conclusion is claimed; the N=100 finite counterexample settles neither. No DOI for this full general-modulus result was authenticated in bounded checks. PR #1224: https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/1224 .
